source: RSNA-STR 2018 adjudicated challenge; NIH CXR patient mapping
target_definition: Calculated radiologist Normal versus Lung Opacity suspicious for pneumonia. Other abnormalities and ambiguous labels excluded. This is a radiographic proxy, not confirmed clinical pneumonia.
sampling: One deterministically sampled image per original NIH patient, then stratified random sampling without replacement. No patient crosses splits.
kaggle: Existing 3801 train / 952 validation. Existing 618 test previously inspected; descriptive regression only.
old_openi: All 200 remain evaluation-only; previously inspected and 40 positive report groups exhausted. No OpenI pixels/labels in fitting or selection.

candidates.features: Frozen current MobileNetV2 backbone GAP, 1280 dimensions; same RGB/float32/resize_with_pad 224 preprocessing
candidates.family: L2 logistic regression on standardized features
candidates.fit_weighting: Equal total weight for each of four domain/class strata; scaler and classifier fitted on train only
candidates.threshold_grid: 0.01..0.99 in steps of 0.005 on validation only
candidates.validation_selection: Require sensitivity >=0.90 Kaggle and >=0.80 RSNA. Maximize minimum domain balanced accuracy, then mean balanced accuracy, then lower C, then higher threshold. If no feasible candidate, keep best descriptive candidate but do not deploy.
candidates.temperature: After selection fit one bounded T in [0.2,5] on domain/class balanced validation NLL; transform threshold by same T to preserve decisions

freeze_before_holdout: Save selected head, threshold, validation selection, source/config hashes and manifest hashes before any holdout or old-test inference

promotion_gate.rsna_new_holdout: accuracy gain >=0.05 AND balanced accuracy gain >=0.05 over existing classifier; sensitivity >=0.80; specificity >=0.70; paired 95% bootstrap accuracy-difference lower bound >0 (10000 resamples, seed 20261021)
promotion_gate.openi_previously_inspected: accuracy gain >=0.05 AND balanced accuracy gain >=0.05; sensitivity >=0.60
promotion_gate.failed_gate: Do not replace production model or claim improved clinical accuracy. Preserve candidate/report locally, publish numeric evidence and next-data requirement. Do not retune on revealed holdout.

limitations: Balanced quota sample; accuracy does not estimate deployment prevalence.
RSNA radiographic opacity labels and OpenI weak report labels are not clinical gold standard.
Original NIH patient identifiers support within-RSNA grouping; identity linkage across source institutions is not verified.
Fresh RSNA holdout is used once; old Kaggle/OpenI results are descriptive rechecks.
No OOD threshold change used to conceal classification errors.
